title: Reading the Fine Print
text:
A rental agreement is a legal contract between a landlord and a tenant. It states the amount of rent, the length of the lease and the rules that both parties must follow. Before signing, a tenant should read every clause carefully, because a single term can have serious consequences. For example, some contracts require a deposit that is only returned if the apartment is left in good condition.

If a dispute arises, the contract usually explains how the problem should be solved. Many agreements include a clause that requires the parties to try mediation before going to court. Although this process can save time and money, it is not always mandatory unless the contract says so clearly. Therefore, professional advice is often useful for tenants who do not understand the legal language.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does a rental agreement state?
options: The amount of rent and the length of the lease

questions.text: What does a common clause in many agreements require before going to court?
options: The parties must try mediation first
The tenant must pay the rent in cash
The landlord must move out of the building
Both parties must sign in front of a judge

questions.text: What can be inferred about tenants who do not understand legal language?
options: They should avoid signing any contract at all
They may benefit from professional advice
They never need to read the contract
They are always treated unfairly by landlords

questions.text: Why does the passage describe reading every clause carefully as important?
options: Clauses are usually written in a foreign language
Landlords never follow the rules of the contract
Tenants cannot change any clause later
A single term can have serious consequences

vocabulary.definition: a formal arrangement between two or more parties
money paid in advance to protect against possible damage or unpaid costs
a disagreement, often a formal or legal one
a process in which a neutral person helps two sides reach an agreement

paragraph_translations: Kira sözleşmesi, ev sahibi ile kiracı arasında yapılan yasal bir sözleşmedir. Kira miktarını, kira süresini ve her iki tarafın uyması gereken kuralları belirtir. İmzalamadan önce kiracı her maddeyi dikkatle okumalıdır, çünkü tek bir hüküm ciddi sonuçlar doğurabilir. Örneğin, bazı sözleşmeler yalnızca daire iyi durumda bırakılırsa iade edilen bir depozito talep eder.

Bir uyuşmazlık çıkarsa, sözleşme genellikle sorunun nasıl çözüleceğini açıklar. Birçok anlaşma, taraflardan mahkemeye gitmeden önce arabuluculuğu denemelerini şart koşan bir madde içerir. Bu süreç zaman ve para tasarrufu sağlayabilir, ancak sözleşme bunu açıkça belirtmediği sürece her zaman zorunlu değildir. Bu nedenle, yasal dili anlamayan kiracılar için profesyonel tavsiye genellikle yararlıdır.
